## Decision

Treat this as a data-integrity incident with an active bleed, not a migration chore.

## Rationale

163 events were written to the unread store on 2026-09-13. The first obligation is to stop silent success, which is independent of and faster than any data move. Folding entirely into the obsidian-native-groundwork cutover and accepting continued bleed was rejected — that motive had no AC covering legacy data and its cutover was not imminent. Doing nothing until the cutover lands was rejected for the same reason.

## Alternatives Considered

- Fold entirely into obsidian-native-groundwork cutover and accept continued bleed — rejected
- Do nothing until cutover lands — rejected
